title: berkheya eriobasis
intro: Berkheya eriobasis, commonly known as the yellow daisy, is a plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of fever, rheumatism, and skin infections. The therapeutic actions of Berkheya eriobasis include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and antiseptic, making it a potential treatment for wounds, burns, and other skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Berkheya eriobasis include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
